## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: A fitness function test (test_no_legacy_config_keys_outside_allowlist) exists in tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh that will fail if new references are added
- DD1 (partial): The fitness function enforces that grep for legacy config keys returns only allowlisted files

## Implementation

Create tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh with the first test function:
test_no_legacy_config_keys_outside_allowlist

### Baseline Capture (run FIRST before writing the test)

```bash
grep -rn 'enforcement\.strategy\|merge\.strategy\|worktree\.isolation_enabled\|attribution\.enabled' \
  plugins/dso/scripts/ plugins/dso/hooks/ plugins/dso/skills/ \
  --include='*.sh' \
  | grep -v 'scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config\.sh\|scripts/read-config\.sh\|scripts/skip-review-check\.sh\|scripts/apply-attribution-trailers\.sh'
```

Run this FIRST. The output is the BASELINE_VIOLATIONS list. Current expected violations:
- plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh (grep reads on lines 14-15)
- plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh (grep read, line ~57)
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh (grep read, line ~41)
- plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/github-bootstrap.sh (merge.strategy comment or read)

Confirm the baseline with the above command, then write the test to assert these files ARE in the violations list (sanity: non-empty baseline) AND that no files OUTSIDE the allowlist have violations.

### Test Design (Given/When/Then)

Given: The plugins/dso tree with current files
When: grep scans *.sh files for escaped legacy config key patterns (enforcement\.strategy, merge\.strategy, worktree\.isolation_enabled, attribution\.enabled) in scripts/ and hooks/ subtrees, excluding known-exempt files (read-config.sh, skip-review-check.sh, apply-attribution-trailers.sh, migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh)
Then: Any matched file MUST be in the explicit BASELINE_VIOLATIONS allowlist; violations outside the allowlist cause a non-empty offenders output → FAIL

### Test Structure

Follow the pattern from tests/scripts/test-no-yaml-config-refs.sh:
1. grep for legacy key patterns in plugins/dso/scripts/ and plugins/dso/hooks/ (--include='*.sh')
2. Filter out comment lines (lines where content after 'file:lineno:' starts with #)
3. Filter out explicitly exempt files (read-config.sh, migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh, skip-review-check.sh, apply-attribution-trailers.sh)
4. Compare remaining hits against a BASELINE_VIOLATIONS allowlist (array of expected file:lineno patterns OR just filenames)
5. assert_eq that offenders-outside-allowlist is empty

SANITY criterion: assert that at least one baseline violation exists (proof the grep ran and found the expected files). This ensures the allowlist was populated from a real scan, not hardcoded empty.

### Test File Location

tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh

Test is NOT fuzzy-match compatible with any source file (it's a fitness function test against multiple source files). Must add .test-index entry.

### RED State

The test must FAIL before Task 2 (GREEN) because it detects current violations (mode-detect.sh, enforcement-gate.sh, merge-to-main.sh) as OUTSIDE-allowlist after those files are removed from the allowlist. At RED time, write the allowlist to include the current violators so the sanity assertion passes but the outside-allowlist assertion shows zero offenders (the test PASSES at RED time for the wrong reason? No — the test should FAIL RED).

CORRECT RED design: The allowlist should contain ONLY the approved files (read-config.sh, migrator, skip-review-check.sh, apply-attribution-trailers.sh). The test runs grep and finds violations in mode-detect.sh, enforcement-gate.sh, merge-to-main.sh which are NOT in the allowlist. The offenders-outside-allowlist is non-empty → test FAILS (RED). After Task 2 removes those stray reads, the grep finds zero violations outside the allowlist → PASS (GREEN).

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh
- [ ] Test file contains function test_no_legacy_config_keys_outside_allowlist
  Verify: grep -q 'test_no_legacy_config_keys_outside_allowlist' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with entry mapping test file to the source files under test
  Verify: grep -q 'test-no-legacy-config-key-refs' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_no_legacy_config_keys_outside_allowlist] for mode-detect.sh
  Verify: grep 'mode-detect\.sh' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index | grep -q '\[test_no_legacy_config_keys_outside_allowlist\]'
- [ ] Running the test produces a FAIL (RED state): mode-detect.sh and enforcement-gate.sh violations are detected as outside the allowlist
  Verify: { bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-no-legacy-config-key-refs.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAIL:'; }
- [ ] Sanity criterion: baseline grep finds at least one existing violation (non-empty baseline proves scan ran)
  Verify: grep -rn 'enforcement\.strategy\|merge\.strategy' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/ $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/hooks/ --include='*.sh' | grep -v 'read-config\.sh\|migrate-dso\|skip-review\|apply-attribution' | grep -qv '^[0-9]*:.*#'
data.title: RED: Write fitness function test_no_legacy_config_keys_outside_allowlist for direct config grep reads
